title: I don't know if anyone will see this...
author: Death_Climax2307
selftext:
I've been trying to create the same project for about 2 years, but I can't get it to do what I want. I should mention that I've mainly been using agents with free templates, But one thing I've noticed is that making the game from scratch without using any engine makes it incredibly more difficult. My question here is, should I try to do the project using a specific engine? I tried doing it with Unity, but the result was the same or even worse. While the topic of Godot is complicated for me, I tried to learn how to use it at one point, but I found it too difficult, so I haven't really tried it, not even with Artificial Intelligence. Is using Godot different? Is it better?

What I've been trying to accomplish is something that took me several years to design, even before the existence of artificial intelligence as such. This is a project I've been designing since I started my degree in video game design and development and digital entertainment back in 2018. This is a project I didn't even start developing before because it's such an ambitious project and probably no one would play it because it's something very personal. It's a video game genre that's practically dead, but in recent years some games have been released that claim to be trying to revive it. The real-time strategy game of civilizations, with a great similarity to Age of Empires or Warcraft 3 or Starcraft 2... 

I say it's something very personal because I grew up with those games; my father, may he rest in peace, taught me those games, and I've loved them ever since, even though I'm not exactly the best at playing them. I would like to not only evolve the genre, nor do I want to revive it; in fact, if I developed this video game, as I said a while ago, probably nobody would play it. It's one of those video game ideas that you need a PhD to understand, and currently, gamers—the target audience—prefer games that give them dopamine 99% of the time. And I imagine that from what I've been repeating you'll understand that the type of game I'm looking for goes against all of that.

A summary or a way of understanding: My idea would be to combine Age of Mythology, Starcraft 2, warshift, Red Faction Guerrilla, Minecraft, The Nebula's Civilization, Teardown, The Stargate Atlantis episode called The Game and the Versus manga (From One, the same creator of One Punch Man and Mob Psycho 100). Basically, adding all that up, you can see it's not that simple. An RTS game with an explorable and destructible 3D map, a variety of species, not only technological development but also Magical and evolutionary development, and a religion as a cross-cutting axis of development.

For some months I paid for chat gpt but only the $20 version, because I could never afford a more expensive plan. For some time now I lost my job and I can't afford anything. But I absolutely refuse to abandon this project, so at least as a last resort I'm posting here. Can someone please explain to me what I'm doing wrong? I know my idea is overly complicated; it literally took me years to come up with it without using artificial intelligence. (Perhaps AI would have come up with it faster.)

PD: I know it's a lot of text... I hope someone reads it and comments or DMs me. I really want to develop this project with someone, or at least learn how to do it the right way. 

Thank you in advance.
